title: Hruday boundary decay of the AM2 creation coefficients for the named constructions
selection_reason: Deliberation loop 1: the AM2 contraction survives in a weighted norm (and extends to a complex coupling disc), so a change of the box boundary reaches supports meeting the cover only through chains of stars, each costing the ball ratio 37888|tau|. This is the first of two steps towards whole-sequence convergence of the named constructions (roadmap goals 1 and 3); the reduced density is BB1.
model: Zero-selected patterned family (AM2/AQ1): SU(2) Kogut-Susskind form on Z^3 at fixed spacing, coarse 24-link factors, selected triple exactly (0,0,0), Haar product reference, 21 omitted faces per anchor with normalized coefficient -(tau/3) per face (delta=alpha/8), both signs |tau|<=10^-8; the AM2 creation expansion with J<=28|tau|, R=1/64, G(t)=16e^{8t}(1+10t); construction families F1 (AQ1 centered whole-star boxes Lambda_N=[-N,N]^3 in coarse coordinates) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained-face boxes with padding on the same Lambda_N), N at least 2; cover R={0,e_z}; the F2 padding sites carry no interaction, so coefficients on supports meeting the padding vanish.

parameters.metric: coarse l-infinity metric on factor sites; every whole star phi_b has support b+S with l-infinity diameter d_X=1 (to be verified by enumeration; an l1 reading with diameter 2 is a labelled alternative, never mixed); any later combination with the coarse l1 Lieb-Robinson constants of BA2 converts explicitly (d_inf at most d_1 at most 3 d_inf)
parameters.weights: forward: diameter-weighted anchored norm ||c||_w = max_u sum_{I containing u} w^{diam(I)} ||c_I||, diam the coarse l-infinity diameter on factor sites; headline w = e^mu = 64 (q = 1/w = 1/64); admissible w from 1 to 390625/148 (self-map J_0 w G(R) at most R); loss factor w^{d_X} = w charged once per interaction term, never per creation; the star-count weight w^{n(I)} (n(I) the least number of stars in a connected cover of I, n(I) at least diam(I)) is a labelled alternative, never mixed with the diameter weight. Difference weight: ||delta||_{B,beta} = max_u sum_{I containing u} e^{beta rho_B(I)} ||delta_I|| with rho_B(I) = max over p in I of d_inf(p,B), where B is the source set of the comparison (the sites met by the interaction terms present in one box and not the other: the shell Lambda_{N+1} minus Lambda_N for nested comparisons, the outer layer max_i |b_i| = N of Lambda_N for F1 versus F2); e^beta = 64 with beta at most mu; the weight grows with distance from B, that is towards R; a weight growing with distance from R, or a non-submultiplicative pure distance weight, is the rejected reversed direction. Reverse: complex coupling z on a disc of declared radius rho at most tau_star = 1/37888 in the J = 28|z| parametrization (self-map 28 rho G(R) at most R with G(R) below 148/7), q = |tau|/rho: rho = tau_star for the floor pair, rho = 64|tau| for the headline pair.

headline.basis: q=1/64 is a chosen decay ratio in [q_min, 1) realized by the weight w=1/q=64 in the diameter-weighted norm (forward) or the disc radius 64|tau| (reverse); it is not the ball radius R=1/64 used as a per-step tree ratio; the per-step floor is q_min=148/390625

rate_floor.tier: named by the producer from the closed vocabulary (crude_majorant or exact_first_order)
rate_floor.route: weighted_norm with w = 390625/148 (forward); analytic_disc with rho = tau_star (reverse)
rate_floor.note: q_min = 37888|tau| = |tau|/tau_star at the cap; the floor rate scales with |tau|

rate_constant_pair.crude_tier_reported: crude_majorant at q = 1/64 reported, not a target
rate_constant_pair.tier_label_rule: every constant carries a tier in {crude_majorant, exact_first_order} and a route in {weighted_norm, analytic_disc}; exact_first_order requires the exact first-order coefficients (AV1) and the self-consistent inequality t at most w t_1/(1 - J w G'(R)) re-derived in the stated norm; mapping from the skeptic prospective ids: crude_i = crude_majorant, exact_first_order_ii = exact_first_order, weighted_i = weighted_norm with crude_majorant, weighted_ii = weighted_norm with exact_first_order

comparisons: F1 on Lambda_N versus F1 on Lambda_{N+1}
F2 on Lambda_N versus F2 on Lambda_{N+1}
F1 versus F2 on the same Lambda_N (exponent N-1)

any two centered boxes Lambda_M and Lambda_M' (M, M' at least N) of F1 or F2, by telescoping and the same-N F1/F2 comparison; separately labelled: any two finite complete-factor volumes of one prescription both containing Lambda_N, compared through their union (input to the BB2 pre-registered translation item)
parameters.cutoff: each on-site cutoff space Q_L (product of 1_[0,L](h_x)), every L (for L at least 24 the first-order coefficients are exact, AV1 section 7); every coefficient statement holds in each Q_L with constants uniform in L; no cutoff removal is applied to coefficients and no untruncated creation expansion is asserted (AM2 section 6 removes the cutoff for eigenvalues and AV1 F20-F23 for the ground vector; reduced densities are BB1/BB2)
parameters.N_min: 2 (every comparison is for N at least 2; the exponent N-1 is then at least 1)
parameters.clock: not applicable to static coefficients; the round clock s=alpha*t_E/hbar, theta=alpha*t/hbar is named in preregistration.clock

required: 1. Name the metric, the weights, the loss per interaction and the difference weight exactly as in parameters; prove (itemized, not by analogy) that the AM2 multilinear estimate HNM-AM2.5 survives in the weighted anchored norm with an explicit loss factor per interaction, and that the ball self-map and Lipschitz inequalities hold in that norm at J=28|tau|, |tau|<=10^-8 for every weight up to the stated maximum (forward), or that the AM2 contraction holds for complex couplings |z|<=tau_star with the coefficient map analytic in z (reverse).

2. Prove the order-versus-distance lemma: a creation coefficient on a support meeting R depends on an interaction term whose support lies at coarse distance at least d from R only at order at least ceil(d/diam) in the coupling, with the diameter convention named; enumerate the stars and supports on Lambda_2 and Lambda_3 to confirm the diameter and the incidence, and give an all-size argument; publish the order-versus-distance tables for both the coarse l-infinity convention (diameter 1) and the l1 convention (diameter 2) on Lambda_2, Lambda_3 and Lambda_4, and state which one the proof uses.

3. Identify exactly the boundary source for each comparison in parameters.comparisons: the interaction terms present in one box and not the other (for F1 versus F2 on the same box: the 28N(5N+1) extra faces, regrouped at their anchors and charged face by face exactly once) and their exact coarse distance from R (derived by enumeration plus an all-size argument).

4. Prove the coefficient-difference bound sum_{I containing u, I meeting R} ||c_I^{box1}-c_I^{box2}|| <= K q^(N-1) for u in R with the frozen headline pair (q=1/64, K<=1/2000000 at the exact first-order tier) and the floor pair (q=148/390625, K at most 1/12), both signs of tau, for every comparison; report the crude-majorant tier separately; never use the global Lipschitz constant 2J_0G'(R) as a decay factor.

5. State plainly that coefficient decay is not decay of the reduced density on R (the normalization couples all supports; that is BB1), and export the gate fields; quote the mandatory sentence template once as one unbroken span.

6. Declare and check the tau -> tau/100 scaling of each headline constant against its bracket in preregistration.scaling_brackets_per_constant; exact finite fixtures for the traps (a weight growing from R that fails; a global Lipschitz bound that does not decay; a per-creation loss charge that fails); every control executed as a damaging mutation.
claim_exclusions: decay of the reduced density or of any state (BB1/BB2)
uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a
any statement about untruncated creation coefficients (AM2 section 6 removes the cutoff for eigenvalues and AV1 F20-F23 for the ground vector; neither defines untruncated coefficients)
direction_note: Forward: weighted anchored norm with loss per interaction and a boundary-distance difference weight. Reverse: complex-coupling analyticity of the AM2 fixed point on |z|<=tau_star plus the order-versus-distance count and Cauchy's estimate. The routes share the AM2 majorant but differ in the decay mechanism; independence is limited to route, enumeration and code.

acceptance.accepted_within_scope: Both routes prove the coefficient-difference bound for every comparison, at both signs, with each proved constant at most its frozen target (the margin of at least 2 is a freeze-time property of the target against the loop-1 previews, not an acceptance condition).
acceptance.limited: Only the floor pair, only one comparison, or only the crude tier is proved; or the diameter convention fails and only the l1 alternative closes.
acceptance.insufficient: The weighted contraction fails at the cap, or the bound is derived from the global Lipschitz constant.

claim_exclusions: uniqueness of every infinite-volume ground state
any estimate uniform in the lattice spacing a

preregistration.error_terms_rule: an entry may be not_applicable only with a stated reason

target.quantity: K at q=1/64 (exact first-order tier) and K at q=148/390625
target.note: blind discriminating threshold for a new estimate; each target has a margin of at least 2 against the loop-1 panel previews, which are recorded in advisor/deliberation-2.md (not a producer premise)

preregistration.mandatory_sentence_template: For the zero-selected patterned family at the same coupling |tau|<=10^-8, and for the named construction families F1 (centered whole-star boxes) and F2 (all-contained-face boxes with padding) on centered coarse cubes, the AM2 creation coefficients in each on-site cutoff space, on supports meeting the cover R, differ between two boxes of the named constructions by at most K q^(N-1) in the anchored norm, uniformly in the cutoff, where N is the smaller box size; this is decay of the coefficients of the named constructions at a rate in N, not decay of the reduced density, not a statement about untruncated creation coefficients, not uniqueness of any ground state, and not a statement uniform in the lattice spacing a.

gate_fields_required.coefficient_cauchy_scope: AM2 creation coefficients of F1 and F2 on supports meeting R, in each on-site cutoff space

forbidden_phrasings: uniqueness of the infinite-volume ground state

scaling_brackets_per_constant.K_exact_first_order_at_q_1_64: [95,105] (linear in tau with a positive nonlinear correction; computed from the same exact formula at tau and tau/100 without intermediate rounding)
scaling_brackets_per_constant.K_floor_pair: [99/100, 101/100] (the floor rate q_min(tau) = 37888|tau| scales with |tau| and K_floor is tau-independent at leading order:  the weighted form at w = 1/q_min is invariant because J w and w t_1 are)

new_control_semantics.coherent_evidence_tampering: Flipping a required control Boolean or removing a declared snapshot with every hash rebound is still rejected.
new_control_semantics.exact_arithmetic_admission: Admission Booleans depend only on Fraction arithmetic with directed enclosures; Arb/mpmath/numpy values are labelled previews and are never read by an admission check.
new_control_semantics.no_priority_or_continuum_claim: results.json carries scientific_priority_verified:false and continuum_claim:false; historical, occult or governmental provenance supplies no premise.
new_control_semantics.changed_model_relabelled: Packet tau, triple, family, metric, weights, window and model id must equal the contract; a uniform-model, other-group, 2D or finite-graph result under the patterned-family label is rejected.
new_control_semantics.insufficient_verdict_retained: A missed target is reported limited/insufficient with its dominating term at unchanged tau, q, mu, N_0; retuning to pass is rejected.
new_control_semantics.tau_scaling_exponent: Each headline constant's exact ratio C(tau)/C(tau/100), computed from the same exact formula without intermediate rounding, lies in its bracket in preregistration.scaling_brackets_per_constant; a bound of the wrong tau order, or a bracket chosen after evaluation, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.wrong_delta_alpha_hbar_clock: Physical clock theta=alpha t/hbar; AQ1 normalized u=theta/8 appears only with the conversion shown; a window stated in u but labelled theta (eightfold error) is rejected.
new_control_semantics.missing_incoming_stars: Per-site sums include incoming anchors (J=28|tau|, four stars); the outgoing-star-only 7|tau| is rejected in every contraction, source and Lieb-Robinson norm.
new_control_semantics.root_n_misuse: Deterministic bounds add linearly over faces, shells and nodes; division by sqrt(N) or sqrt(#faces) is rejected.
new_control_semantics.tier_mixing_rejected: Every constant names its tier in {crude_majorant, exact_first_order} and its route in {weighted_norm, analytic_disc}; an exact_first_order constant uses the exact first-order coefficients (AV1) with the self-consistent inequality t at most w t_1/(1 - J w G'(R)) re-derived in the norm in which it is stated; an exact first-order source combined with a crude_majorant t is labelled crude_majorant; any other mixing is rejected.
new_control_semantics.reverse_premise_isolation: The reverse inputs/ inventory equals AGENTS.md, this contract and shared_premises exactly; it contains no skeptic triage, recommendation, prospective-controls or loop-2 review, no deliberation, no lens memo, recommendation or loop-2 response, and no forward file of this loop.
new_control_semantics.face_count_all_sites: 49 faces per factor, 15 owner sets, 82 meeting R, 10 inside R derived from the I1 table by translation covariance; literals or site-0-only counts are rejected.
new_control_semantics.uniform_in_N_not_in_a: Every uniformity statement says 'in N at fixed spacing'; a uniformity claim in the lattice spacing, or an unqualified uniformity word next to a rate, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.placeholder_span_rejected: (freezer R1) Any angle-bracket span containing whitespace, a vertical bar or 'e.g.' blocks the freeze; inequalities in contract strings are written in words or with one bracket direction per string.
new_control_semantics.negation_aware_phrase_scan: tools/phrase_scan.py (round list plus preregistration.forbidden_phrasings) is run whole-sentence and negation-aware on report, results and gate texts with the mandatory template removed as one literal; an affirmative hit is rejected.
new_control_semantics.parameters_declare_metric_weights_window: Metric, d_X, weights (w=e^mu, e^beta), N_0, the time window and the clock are fields of parameters, not prose; absence blocks the freeze.
new_control_semantics.global_lipschitz_not_decay: The admitted sup-norm Lipschitz constant 2J_0G'(R) below 77/390625 bounds ||c^{N+1}-c^N||_a only by 37/6249384 with no decay; using it as a per-shell decay factor is rejected.
new_control_semantics.weighted_norm_contraction_rechecked: The weighted AM2 inequalities J_0 w G(R) at most R (w at most 390625/148) and the Lipschitz condition are re-evaluated as exact rationals with the declared w; citing the unweighted AM2 constants for the weighted ball is rejected.
new_control_semantics.loss_per_interaction_not_per_creation: The weight loss e^{mu d_X} is charged once per interaction term; omitting it, or charging it only per creation, is rejected by a fixture where the output diameter exceeds the sum of creation diameters by d_X.
new_control_semantics.diameter_subadditivity_through_interacti: diam(M) at most d_X+sum_j diam(I_j) is derived from 'each I_j meets X'; a fixture with M=N minus X (disconnected output) must still satisfy it, and a max-instead-of-sum shortcut is rejected where invalid.
new_control_semantics.coarse_metric_named: The metric (coarse l_inf or l1 on factor indices) and d_X (1 or 2) are declared in parameters; mixing metrics between the weight and the distance is rejected.
new_control_semantics.weight_direction_toward_source: The difference weight e^{beta rho_B(I)}, rho_B(I) = max over p in I of d_inf(p,B), grows with distance from the source set B of the comparison (towards R); a weight growing with distance from R, or a non-submultiplicative pure distance weight, is rejected by a fixture.
new_control_semantics.cardinality_weight_rate_labelled: If support-size weights e^{mu|I|} are used, the loss e^{4 mu} and the rate q at least 0.1395 per site are stated; relabelling it as the diameter rate 3.79e-4 is rejected.
new_control_semantics.boundary_distance_exact: Distances are derived: shell Lambda_{N+1} minus Lambda_N at l_inf distance N from e_z (N+1 from 0), F2 outer layer at N-1; an off-by-one exponent is rejected.
new_control_semantics.boundary_source_new_terms_only: The source contains only interaction terms added from Lambda to Lambda' (each meeting the source set); a source charged with old terms, or new terms not meeting it, is rejected.
new_control_semantics.f2_regrouping_charged_once: F2 clipped groups that gain faces from N to N+1 are charged face by face (per-site face sum 49|tau|/3 at most J) and never twice.
new_control_semantics.rate_constant_pair_prefrozen: The headline (q, K) and the weights are frozen in the contract; optimizing q per N after the constants are seen and reporting it as the rate is rejected (a proved family q in [q_min,1) may be reported as labelled).
new_control_semantics.q_min_not_crossed: A rate below the proved minimum q_min = J G(r)/r at the declared radius (148/390625 at r = R = 1/64) is rejected; a rate proved at another radius is reported only with that radius named.
new_control_semantics.analytic_route_disc_radius: The analyticity route uses a declared disc radius rho at most tau_star = 1/37888 (self-map 28 rho G(R) at most R) with q = |tau|/rho (rho = tau_star for the floor pair, rho = 64|tau| for the headline pair) and the order-versus-distance count; extending it to rho_R without a proved zero-free region for the complexified normalization is rejected.
new_control_semantics.untruncated_coefficients_not_asserted: Every coefficient statement holds in each on-site cutoff space Q_L with constants uniform in L; no cutoff removal is applied to coefficients and no untruncated creation expansion is asserted (AM2 section 6 removes the cutoff for eigenvalues, AV1 F20-F23 for the ground vector).
new_control_semantics.decay_rate_in_N_not_a: q is per coarse step at fixed spacing and strong bare coupling (a coarse step is (4a,2a,a)); a conversion to fm, a physical length-scale reading or a rate in the lattice spacing is rejected.
new_control_semantics.coefficient_decay_not_marginal_decay: A fixture where coefficients meeting R are unchanged but an outside coefficient changes rho_R through a straddling support (AV1 F13 type) must be exhibited; inferring state decay from coefficient decay alone is rejected.
new_control_semantics.two_families_named: F1 (AQ1 whole-star boxes) and F2 (I1 section 6 all-contained faces with padding) on centered Lambda_N, N at least 2, declared before production; a class, if used, is frozen.
new_control_semantics.subsequence_versus_whole_sequence: Every limit statement says whole sequence or subsequence; whole-sequence claims come only from a Cauchy bound.
new_control_semantics.ball_radius_not_used_as_tree_decay_ratio: A packet that uses the ball radius R=1/64 itself as the per-step tree ratio (instead of a chosen weight w with its own contraction check, or q_min=37888|tau|) is rejected.
